business_summary: Toray Industries, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, and sells fibers and textiles, performance chemicals, carbon fiber composite materials, water treatment and healthcare, and other products in Japan, Asia, China, America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers filament yarns, staple fibers, and spun yarns, as well as woven and knitted fabrics of nylon, polyester, acrylics, and others; non-woven fabrics; and apparel products. It also provides nylon, ABS, PBT, PPS, and other resins and molded products; polyolefin foam products; polyester, polyethylene, polypropylene, and other films; processed film products; raw materials for synthetic fibers and other plastics; fine chemicals; electronic and information materials; and graphic materials. In addition, the company offers carbon fibers, carbon fiber composite materials, and molded products; analysis, physical evaluation, etc.; and pharmaceuticals, medical devices, etc. Further, it provides engineering services; industrial equipment and machinery; water treatment membranes and related equipment; and materials for housing, building, and civil engineering applications. Additionally, it offers TORAYVINO, a household water purifier; Toraysee, a cleaning cloth made with ultra-microfiber; 3D-Gene, a high-sensitivity DNA chip; materials and solutions for automobiles; and semiconductors combined support for materials, equipment, and analysis, as well as provides services, including design, procurement, and construction of factory building, air conditioning, production equipment, and utilities right. It offers its products through & +, Ultrasuede, Ecsaine, senbism, LIVMOA, hitoe, 3DeFX+, and TORAIN brand names. The company was formerly known as Toyo Rayon Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Toray Industries, Inc. in 1970. Toray Industries, Inc. was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Toray Industries, Inc.는 자회사와 함께 일본, 아시아, 중국, 미국, 유럽 및 국제적으로 섬유 및 직물, 기능성 화학 물질, 탄소 섬유 복합 재료, 수처리 및 의료 및 기타 제품을 제조, 가공 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 필라멘트사, 스테이플 섬유, 방적사뿐만 아니라 나일론, 폴리에스테르, 아크릴 등으로 만든 직조 및 편직물도 제공합니다. 부직포; 그리고 의류제품. 또한 나일론, ABS, PBT, PPS 등의 수지 및 성형품도 제공합니다. 폴리올레핀 폼 제품; 폴리에스테르, 폴리에틸렌, 폴리프로필렌 등의 필름; 가공된 필름 제품; 합성섬유 및 기타 플라스틱 원료; 정밀화학물질; 전자 및 정보 자료; 및 그래픽 자료. 또한, 회사는 탄소섬유, 탄소섬유 복합재료, 성형품 등을 제공하고 있습니다. 분석, 신체평가 등 의약품, 의료기기 등을 제공합니다. 또한 엔지니어링 서비스도 제공합니다. 산업용 장비 및 기계류; 수처리 막 및 관련 장비; 주택, 건축, 토목공학 용도의 재료 등을 보유하고 있습니다. 또한 TORAYVIN을 제공합니다.
